notes.title: # Version Update v0.1133
notes.content:
1. Adjusted the Boss resurrection mechanism: the resurrection time has been shortened from 30 minutes to 10 minutes to improve challenge efficiency.

2. Optimized the new player experience: Reduced the HP and defense of "Qi Gathering" monsters in the Novice Village to ease initial combat pressure.

3. Welfare adjustment: Increased the number of spirit beast eggs given by Senior Sister of Yushou Peak to 4, helping players with early-stage development.

4. Map optimization: Adjusted the battle map of the Boss in the "Yukong Flight" quest to optimize the battle scene experience.

5. Mall adjustment: Reduced the price of skill books to make it easier for players to obtain key skills.

6. Detailed optimization: User experience upgrades.
